Our USP

Translate documents into Hindi and Indian languages

Most PDF tools stop at English. E-Docs translates the whole document, keeps paragraphs in place, and gives you a file you can send straight away.

  1. Paste text or upload a filePDF, Word (DOCX) or TXT. E-Docs reads the text for you, up to 60,000 characters at a time.
  2. Pick the languagesLeave “Detect language” on, or choose the source. One-click presets for English ⇄ Hindi, Marathi and Tamil.
  3. Download the resultCopy the text, or download it as TXT, Word or PDF, with proper fonts for each script.

Whole files, not just lines

Upload a circular, letter or notice and get the full translated document back.

Right script, right font

Devanagari, Gujarati, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Gurmukhi render correctly. Urdu is written right to left.

No API key, no setup

Open the tool and translate. Nothing to configure, nothing to pay.

Translation needs an internet connection and sends the text (not your file) to an online translation service. Machine translation can be imperfect, so review important documents.

What is stored when you log in

Exactly this, and nothing more.

Your account

Name, email and password. The password is stored only as a bcrypt hash, so nobody can read it, not even us.

Your output files

After a tool finishes, the result file (for example the merged PDF) is saved to your account in our MongoDB database. Translated files you download are saved too. Up to 100 MB per file.

History entries

For each saved file: which tool made it, the file name, its size and the date and time.

Sign-in token

A signed token in your browser keeps you logged in for 30 days. Sign out to remove it.

Never stored

  • The original files you upload into a tool
  • Anything you do as a guest
  • The source text or file you translate (only the translated file you download is saved)
  • Files from the PDF to Word server converter (deleted right after conversion)

You stay in control

  • Delete any saved file from History or a tool page; it is removed from the database
  • Sign out any time to remove the sign-in token from your browser
  • Site administrators can see and remove saved files for support and safety
  • Your recent tools and language choice are kept only in your own browser

Private by default

E-Docs is built so your documents stay with you.

Runs on your device

Merging, splitting, compressing, converting, signing, OCR, passwords and redaction all happen inside your browser. The file never leaves your computer or phone.

Two clear exceptions

Translate sends only the text to a translation service. PDF to Word may send the file to our server for a better layout, and the file is deleted right after. If the server converter is not available, it runs in your browser instead.

Hashed passwords

Account passwords are hashed with bcrypt before they are stored.

Locked-down API

Our server only answers requests coming from the E-Docs website.

Any device

Works in any modern browser on laptop or phone. Nothing to install.

Frequently asked questions


Is E-Docs really free?

Yes. All 28 tools, including translation, are free. There is no watermark and no limit on how many times you use a tool.

Do I need an account?

No. Every tool works as a guest. Sign in only if you want your output files saved so you can download them again later.

Are my files uploaded?

Most tools run entirely inside your browser, so the file never leaves your device. Two exceptions: translation sends the text (not the file) to an online translation service, and PDF to Word may use our server converter for better layout, which deletes the file right after. If you are signed in, the finished output file is saved to your account.

Which languages can I translate?

English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Urdu, in any direction. The source language can be detected automatically.

Can I translate a whole PDF or Word file?

Yes. Upload a PDF, DOCX or TXT and E-Docs reads the text, translates it and lets you download the result as TXT, Word or PDF. Up to 60,000 characters at a time.

Is machine translation accurate?

It is good for everyday documents, but not perfect. Please have a person review legal, medical or official documents before you use them.

Who can see my saved files?

You can. Site administrators can also see the list of saved files and remove them, for support and to keep the service safe. Guest files are never stored, so nobody can see them.

How do I delete my saved files?

Open History, or the “Your recent files” panel on any tool page, and click the delete icon. The file is removed from our database.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. E-Docs works in any modern phone browser. Scan to PDF can use your phone camera.

Can a scanned PDF be translated?

Run OCR PDF first to turn the scanned images into text, then translate the result.
